cls.nephrotoxic: Drugs with a kidney injury warning

rows: Avoid unless levels are monitored frequently.
ACE inhibitors or ARBs plus a diuretic ("triple whammy")
Avoid the triple combination; if unavoidable, hydrate and check creatinine and potassium within 1 week.
